notes.title: Post-Gamescom Update
notes.content: [p]Hey everyone![/p][p] [/p][p]Ever since coming back from Gamescom we’ve been working on the next batch of changes to Green Again. With Sproutlings are going to Tokyo Game Show soon as part of our publisher Slug Disco, I think this is a good time to polish the game a bit more for our next event appearance.[/p][p] [/p][p]The focus of this update is to make the gameplay more fluid and intuitive, with a variety of optimizations and changes to the UI and game flow. There’s also a number of fixes implemented. See below for the full changelog:[/p][p] [/p][list][*][p]Added "no materials" icon for buildings which are missing materials to finish construction[/p][/*][*][p]Growing seasons of current crop are shown in the crop switch panel[/p][/*][*][p]Reduced power consumption of some buildings[/p][/*][*][p]Update season changed tooltip when changing language[/p][/*][*][p]Made faster and fastest game speed settings a bit faster[/p][/*][*][p]Improved tutorial item pacing, changed tutorial order so panning tutorial is not skipped[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed loreleaf monolith spawning in a ring of cliffs occasionally[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed some localization bugs[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed pods tutorial message icons[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed construction costs being added to worker inventories twice[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed bug causing crops to be shown as harvestable when they aren't yet[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed a bug in quest generation timing[/p][/*][/list]

notes.title: July Round-Up! ♟️
notes.content: [h3][b]Hi Sproutling fans![/b][/h3][p][/p][p]Summer 2025 is truly a season of exciting events for our busy and hardworking Sproutlings, with two exciting Steam festivals in July and then Gamescom coming up in August. That’s right, Green Again is going to Gamescom! We’ll cover that in more detail in this monthly round-up so let’s dive right in![/p][p][/p][p][/p][h2]Steam Events + Lore Tree Update[/h2][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44781286/26c2fa63cb0867ede6e98bd799b55bbf896edede.png"][/img][/p][p]We (and our Sproutlings) were thrilled to take part in [url="https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/2718320/view/545613182900636657?l=english"]TactiCon[/url], a major Steam convention highlighting all kinds of strategy games. To let the Sproutlings showcase more of their strategic side, we have introduced the Lore Tree Update earlier in July before the event. Players now have access to a new upgrade system that offers various buffs across all maps to help the Sproutlings reclaim their planet.[/p][p][/p][p]A follow-up patch was implemented afterwards as well to polish the new Lore Tree further and improve the game with fixes, optimizations and visual changes. For example, Buildings will now once again update their looks alongside tech upgrades. You can see the full patch notes [url="https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/2718320/view/545615175941619807?l=english"]here[/url]! [/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44781286/3196ee9f7f2df7f5e9be12b224c834a36bce85b9.png"][/img]  [/p][p]We also got to join [url="https://store.steampowered.com/sale/SimFest2025"]SimFest 2025[/url], which was running alongside TactiCon. As a colony sim with hardworking Sproutlings, Green Again of course cannot miss out on this opportunity to share our appreciation for games emphasizing the importance of workers and resources![/p][p][/p][h2]GamesCom!![/h2][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44781286/d60bedba8fe019792a0d64efbb7ac347d0cef17f.png"][/img]With our July agenda all wrapped up, the Sproutlings are now preparing for Gamescom in August. This year, Green Again is fortunate to have the opportunity to exhibit at Indie Arena Booth alongside a myriad of indie games. This is the Sproutlings’ first time showing their work in such a massive event, and they are all pumped up with excitement! If you are going to Gamescom this year, be sure to visit our booth and say hi![/p][p][/p][p]And on that note, we'll be ending the July blog post here. The Sproutlings need to start packing for their trip to Cologne! For those joining us at Gamescom, we'll see you in a few weeks. If you are not able make it to the event, we can always catch up again in the next monthly round-up! Follow us on our socials (links below) to keep an eye on all our updates![/p][p][/p][p][url="https://x.com/GreenAgainGame" style="button" buttoncolor="#319915"]Twitter[/url] [url="https://www.youtube.com/@GreenAgainGame" style="button" buttoncolor="#319915"]YouTube[/url] [url="https://www.tiktok.com/@greenagaingame" style="button" buttoncolor="#319915"]TikTok[/url][/p][p][/p][h2][/h2]

notes.title: TactiCon Update ♟️
notes.content: [p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44781286/907fb5c0670b7698f89d685120bd869ddea103bd.png"][/img][/p][p][b]Green Again is taking part in TactiCon from July 17-21![/b] To prepare the Sproutlings for this big event, here's a new update! Certain buildings, including base structures, wells, farms and outposts, will have a more advanced-looking sprites as you unlock more of the tech tree. It was temporarily removed in recent versions due to the Lore Tree changes and has now been reimplemented in a more straightforward and noticeable format.[/p][p] [/p][p]For the full change log, you can see below:[/p][list][*][p]Added sound and VFX indicating finished Loreleaf objective[/p][/*][*][p]Exposed foundry core is indicated by lightning effects[/p][/*][*][p]Toggled (minimized) UI panels remember their last state[/p][/*][*][p]Progress is shown in the description of terraform Loreleaf objective[/p][/*][*][p]Loreleaf icon is displayed as a resource on monolith when gather tool is enabled[/p][/*][*][p]Buildings are visibly upgraded when tech level increases (via unlocking tech tree items)[/p][/*][*][p]Added extra juice to Loreleaf unlock visuals[/p][/*][*][p]Appended missions are cleaned up after restarting a zone[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed monoliths spawning too close to base[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed stuck monolith particles when zone is restarted[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed save/load enabling Loreleaf objectives in a finished zone without restarting the zone[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed Loreleaf monolith being buildable and farmable[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed monolith cleared by placing farm next to it[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed drones spawning in town zone after creative mode is enabled[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed flipped mushroom shadows when leaving winter[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed potential nullref exception in worker despawn logic[/p][/*][*][p]Added old save version warning message[/p][/*][/list][p] [/p]

notes.title: June Round-Up (New Update!)🌳
notes.content:
[h3][b]Heya Sproutling fans![/b][/h3][p] [/p][p]Green Again got a major update with the new Forge Zone back in March, and it’s about time for another big one! The Lore Tree has been introduced to the game to give the Sproutlings even more support on their terraforming endeavours. In our June monthly round-up, we'll be covering this new upgrade system in detail. [/p][p][/p][h2]The Lore Tree[/h2][p]A currency called [i][b]Loreleaves[/b][/i] can be earned in each world playthrough by completing and replaying levels, achieving objectives, growing your settlement, or collecting Loreleaf monoliths. You can then use these Loreleaves to unlock upgrades on the Lore Tree, ranging from boosting farm production to buffing buildings and Sproutlings![/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44781286/56fa3665a336808d9570554681b51612ffaf9002.png"][/img][/p][p]The Lore Tree applies its effects across all zones in the same save file, and does not reset upon starting a new game in a different zone (unlike the previous tech tree). This should make each run easier and more satisfying as you accumulate rewards over time. It can also be accessed from either the world map or mid-game to be reset anytime, allowing you to customize your strategies whenever you like.[/p][p] [img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44781286/8ec120e27202633a40b7902972b002363953b923.png"][/img][/p][p]Aside from the Lore Tree, this update also introduced a variety of decorations and other changes to freshen up your settlements. You can find the full change log at the end of this blog post.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44781286/5e9949bee854e5f9ed445866e0767cc6ac25036b.png"][/img][/p][p][i]Note: Older save files might not be compatible with this latest version. We recommend starting a new save on the new patch.[/i][/p][p]
[/p][h2]What's Next?[/h2][p]We’d like to add more upgrades and customizations to Green Again to increase gameplay variety. There are plans for prebuilt base structures that give players a head start every game, though this will something to work on later. Right now, we’ll be focusing on consolidating the Lore Tree system with further balancing and expansions in the upcoming patches.[/p][p] [/p][p][/p][p]The Lore Tree is now ripe for harvest. Check it out in Green Again’s demo and let us know what you think! Your feedback would be really appreciated on how we shape the Lore Tree in the future. Join and follow us on [url="https://x.com/GreenAgainGame"]Twitter[/url], [url="https://www.youtube.com/@GreenAgainGame"]YouTube[/url] and [url="https://www.tiktok.com/@greenagaingame"]TikTok[/url] to share your thoughts and get the latest news of Green Again![/p][p][/p][p][/p][h2]Change log:[/h2][list][*][p]Added loreleaves which can be used to unlock lore tree gift upgrades[/p][/*][*][p]Added several lore tree gifts[/p][/*][*][p]Added various loreleaf objectives[/p][/*][*][p]Added loreleaf monoliths[/p][/*][*][p]Moved some of the upgrades from tech tree to lore tree[/p][/*][*][p]Added willow, reeds and three different mushroom decorations[/p][/*][*][p]Added new oak tree art[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed junkyard decoration card size[/p][/*][*][p]Updated recycler generation, starting recycler count should be more consistent[/p][/*][/list]

notes.title: May Round-Up (Demo Update!)🌱
notes.content:
[b][h3]Hi Sproutling fans![/h3][/b]

Summer is here! The warm weather is perfect for our Sproutlings to ramp up their farming and stock up on food and electricity for later in the year. To aid their terraforming endeavours, we just dropped a new patch for the demo. Let’s see what the Sproutlings are getting in this update!

[h2]New Demo Update![/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44781286/63d6f3c5e18385700e21f62089e934d556fb7b1f.png[/img]
The biggest gameplay change in this patch is the new decoration unlock system. Now certain decorations can only be unlocked in specific zones, and the unlocked decorations will carry over to different maps within the same world playthrough. We have also tuned down the fires in the Forge Zone and made them more forgiving. You can find the full change log below 👇

[b]Change log:[/b]
[list]
[*] Added new decoration unlock system, each zone has several related decoration unlockables
[*] Adjusted fire tuning, less punishing fire spread in Forge
[*] Fields which don't meet the soil requirement of the swap target crop become empty, a warning is shown on UI if the soil is insufficient
[*] Some messages (e.g. drones) are shown as tutorial messages on the left when the tutorial is active
[*] Sprinkler description now mentions revealing fogged areas
[*] Fixed some string errors
[*] Fixed power recalculation bug when save is reloaded
[*] Fixed uncaptured and fogged reactors shown in power overlay
[*] Fixed buggy decoration repair, workers repeatedly walking to damaged decorations
[*] Fixed auto-pause UI elements unpausing the game even if it had been paused before opening them
[*] Improved crop switch panel positioning and visibility over other UI elements
[*] Drone spawning in Town is now linked to player progress
[/list]
	
[h2]Indie Assemble[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44781286/76695c647df7141a4812bf21ad4e5880c707c287.png[/img]
Earlier this month, the Sproutlings worked diligently to showcase Green Again at [url=https://store.steampowered.com/curator/44717737-Indie-Assemble/sale/indieassemble]Indie Assemble[/url], a massive indie games Steam event with an extensive collection from around the world. With over 1,000 games from more than 600 development studios, it was the perfect occasion to explore Steam’s vast library of indie games. 


Let us know what you think about the new changes to Green Again, and please look forward to more content coming to the Game. For more news on Green Again, follow us on [url=https://x.com/GreenAgainGame]Twitter[/url], [url=https://www.youtube.com/@GreenAgainGame]YouTube[/url] and [url=https://www.tiktok.com/@greenagaingame]TikTok[/url]. See you next month!

notes.title: April Round-Up! 🌱
notes.content:
[h3][b]Hello Sproutlings![/b][/h3]

How are you enjoying the new update? Have you managed to retake the Forge Zone? The last month has been a busy one for our Sproutlings. After our big Forge Zone update and Colony Fest in the end of March, we jumped straight into more events in April and closed off the month with a new update patch. Let’s check them out!


[h2]Update: Tutorial, Optimizations and Fixes[/h2]
Green Again just received another update! To streamline the tutorial and make the demo more engaging, we have made some changes to both the UI and gameplay of Green Again. Here is the full patch notes of this recent update:
[list]
[*] Streamlined tutorial system with new UI layout, auto-progressing steps, more interactive tasks
[*] Upgraded EMP light towers can target capacitors
[*] Show sprinkler coverage for planned sprinkler towers too
[*] Fixed crops partially stuck after multiple crop switches in quick succession
[*] Changed harvest division slider to steps of 10 to allow 50-50 division
[*] Cleaned up leaving reasons, Increased leaving tolerance when player is placing upgraded houses
[*] Fixed tutorial not resetting padlocks when reset from main menu and loading into a world
[*] Fixed issues with outpost water path validator
[*] Added countdown to light tower recharge inspector
[/list]
What do you think about these changes? Feel free to comment on our Steam discussion forum or even on our [url=https://discord.gg/255cXuckVP]Discord server[/url] to let us know!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44781286/ca03bbac11865af0c5e0d30b164a43f9fb4039c8.png[/img]

[h2]April Events[/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44781286/13f6f1f95724c9085b1c4aec95c7a8f9a7832d68.png[/img]
The Sproutlings took part in the [url=https://store.steampowered.com/sale/EarthAppreciationFestival2025]Earth Appreciation Festival[/url] this year again to celebrate our dear Earth! This time we even got to show off our new update in the showcase video! 
ICYMI, here’s Green Again’s segment with our solo developer Máté Mészáros introducing Green Again and the new update!

[previewyoutube=7RxFixYSmwU;full][/previewyoutube]
We also got to join the [url=https://store.steampowered.com/sale/londongamesfestival2025]London Games Festival[/url] - super excited to display our Sproutlings alongside so many awesome titles, both released and upcoming. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44781286/72db49a9439b7d8a898654c0e36ff3e0d706c2f2.png[/img]

The hardworking Sproutlings got so much done this month, and we are so proud of them. There's even more great news coming next, so follow us on [url=https://x.com/GreenAgainGame]Twitter[/url], [url=https://www.youtube.com/@GreenAgainGame]YouTube[/url] and [url=https://www.tiktok.com/@greenagaingame]TikTok[/url] to get the latest updates. See you next month for more news on Green Again!

notes.title: March Round-Up! 🔥🤖
notes.content:
[b]Hello Sproutlings![/b]

March marks the start of Spring and it’s time to prepare for another year of farming – with a new area and an updated tool kit! Let’s dive into this monthly update and check out what the Sproutlings were up to!

[h3]Demo Update[/h3]
[previewyoutube=KbZIuDsASOI;full][/previewyoutube]

ICYMI, we just had a major update to Green Again’s demo with a plethora of new content. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44781286/78a94f57949f27fc5c2a92d4efb85fc414733aed.gif[/img]
This update introduces the new [b]Forge Zone[/b] where robots have built foundries and set the area ablaze.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44781286/7c59e0479bb6ea2c104b2a548028ce27b63a1ebc.gif[/img]
Sproutlings will not only have to fight back hostile drones, but also devastating [b]wild fires[/b]! 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44781286/1811e58db659127c4b430298ab7fd33c10c80e9b.gif[/img]
Luckily Sproutlings now have access to new technology including the [b]Sprinkler[/b] building, which not only water plants but also put out fires around it!

Join the Sproutlings in our updated demo and reclaim nature from the defective robots! For more details about this new update, here’s the full [url=https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/2718320/view/545604485921112191?l=english]patch notes[/url]!


[h3]Steam's City Builder & Colony Sim Fest[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44781286/eaca4d76f2261a2b90dfb348960ae335786a7bc7.png[/img]
The update made it just in time for this Steam event, and the Sproutlings are very proud to display their work alongside so many incredible titles! Just look at the Sproutling working hard on our key art!


That was surely a busy month for our Sproutlings, and they aren't ready to take a break just yet! Keep your eyes peeled for more news on Green Again and follow us on [url=https://x.com/GreenAgainGame]Twitter[/url], [url=https://www.youtube.com/@GreenAgainGame]YouTube[/url] and [url=https://www.tiktok.com/@greenagaingame]TikTok[/url]. notes.title: Forge Zone Demo Update ⚙️🤖
notes.content:
[previewyoutube=KbZIuDsASOI;full][/previewyoutube]
[b]Greetings Sproutling Fans![/b]

Spring is here and so is our first big demo update in 2025 – new map, new challenges and new upgrades! Let’s check out all the new content in Green Again!

[h3]The Forge Zone[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44781286/bc5ced64726fd30b24af760074c15ea66ab2fc57.png[/img]
Introducing the [b]Forge Zone[/b], a brand-new biome with new tiles, new obstacles and new buildings. This will be the biggest challenge so far for our dear Sproutlings… Do they have what it takes to bring nature back to these lands plagued by malfunctioning robots?

[h3]New Threats[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44781286/b30d644bfb777c74bca8dbb006ce8fd82b62aa34.png[/img]
[b]Bot factories[/b] and [b]foundries[/b] can be found across the new Forge Zone, imposing new challenges to your settlements. New drones emerge from bot factories to roam the map and harass the Sproutlings; foundries ignite [b]wildfires[/b] that spread across the map, laying waste to your buildings and crops.

[h3]New Buildings and Tech[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44781286/eb8c86517e26e3030cf5b037de43cc7f74d674df.png[/img]
To combat the new threats, the Sproutlings now has [b]updated buildings and technology[/b]. Sprinkler towers can be used for both watering the crops and suppressing fires. New upgrades are also available to defeat the drones and boost production. 

And of course, the Forge Zone isn't the only thing being added to Green Again. We've also introduced various additions to other parts of the game. You can find the full patch notes below for all the details of the update!

Join us on [url=https://discord.gg/255cXuckVP]Discord[/url], [url=https://www.youtube.com/@GreenAgainGame]YouTube[/url], [url=https://x.com/GreenAgainGame]Twitter[/url] and [url=https://www.tiktok.com/@greenagaingame]TikTok[/url] to get the latest news on Green Again, and share with us any feedback you have on our game! 


[h3]Changelog:[/h3]
[list]
[*]New Forge zone – the most challenging area featuring new buildings and new tile set
[*]New Fire system – Forge Zone foundries set surrounding tiles on fire; buildings are now flammable; Sproutlings take on the role of firefighters to protect their land
[*]Bot factories spawning new drones with more dynamic drone behavior (they actively harass the colony when aggressive, patrolling between factories)
[*]Sprinkler towers which can be used for both fire protection and watering fields
[*]New objectives and challenges in the junkyard zone
[*]Light tower EMP upgrade makes the light towers much more effective against both jellyfish and shielded drones
[*]Darklight converters upgrade allowing power production at night
[*]New SFX (both in-game and UI)
[*]UI features: "Don't show again" checkbox for tutorial messages, Tooltip delay configuration slider
[*]Misc UI improvements, Bugfixes and optimization
[/list]

notes.title: 2024 Round-Up! ❄️
notes.content:
[h3][b]Hi Sproutling fans![/b][/h3]

How’s everyone Christmas? 2024 will soon be over and Green Again surely had an amazing and eventful year. Normally, we do a general monthly wrap-up once…well, every month. But this is the end of the year so instead, let’s look back at what we’ve accomplished throughout 2024! 


[h2]Updates in 2024![/h2]
2024 has been a year of many updates and a lot of new content for Green Again. Here’s a rundown of the notable changes this year: 

[list]
[*][b]Amazing soundtracks[/b] by [url=https://www.instagram.com/filmandgamemusic]Tobi Weiss[/url] – Sit back and relax to the tunes of Green Again (Also, they say plants grow better with music)

[*][b]Introducing robotic threats[/b] – Peaceful farming is over. Players now need to defend their farms from the malfunctioning automatons
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44781286/551402944746e43f452d3be4a59815755270e2f6.png[/img]

[*][b]Art refresh[/b] – Sproutlings got a new look (designed by [url=https://www.penzilladesign.com/)]Penzilla[/url]!)
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44781286/ac044d124f6d1c115e747f3ace58dc8eda52f20b.png[/img]

[*][b]Daylight cycle[/b] – The winter night descends, plunging the world into snowfall and darkness
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44781286/1d99735d2274df758af228c61c8a0eb3711093b0.png[/img]

[*][b]Power system[/b] – store electricity and light up your settlements during dark winter nights!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44781286/59ea12eab6e0e1cd95f14eda0f0f01a689efcc52.png[/img]

[*][b]Crop switching mechanic[/b] – rotate your crops as seasons go by. Plan your farming and adapt to the climate like real farmers!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44781286/13e4331db0849068ecdde0a12c21d352020571cd.png[/img]

[*][b]Overlay Views[/b] – easy access to your settlement’s information at the click of your mouse
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44781286/f88e34a831758d053d7d8cac188fe3844edb56b0.png[/img]

[*][b]The recent Christmas update[/b] – Festive decorations and Sproutlings in cute hats!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44781286/2c7c709436ad05f105be6cc5fab3284c1fcf4048.png[/img]

[*]And of course, [b]numerous optimizations and fixes[/b] to make Green Again an even better colony building experience.
[/list]
Green Again already looks so different in just a year’s time. We really can’t wait to show you what’s to come in 2025. In [url=https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/2718320/view/4469352795967848549?l=english]one of our previous community round-ups[/url], Green Again’s solo dev Máté has already mentioned some of his future plans for the game. ICYMI, here’s a quick summary:
[list]
[*]New building health system – enables more interactions with buildings such as damage and repairs
[*]Forge Zone – a new biome that will contain more industrial elements
[*]A more elaborate tech tree – assist Sproutlings against challenges both old and new
[/list]

[h2]New Key Art![/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44781286/2bb96d84cb69f3911e0bb5ef0dee8cceacccd3a3.png[/img]
With the in-game art refresh, we feel it would be most appropriate to update our key art as well for a better representation of our Sproutling’s new look. So in July, we got this colourful art to showcase not only the new Sproutlings, but also our buildings and farms. 


[h2]Events we joined![/h2]
Sproutlings are hard at work this year to bring Green Again to a wider audience across different events, both virtual and physical. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44781286/a4a22c58b850132ba98eb564bade72bb91569bd2.jpg[/img]
This April, Sproutlings went to London for the WASD convention. It was incredibly fun to see players trying out Green Again in person and giving us plenty of helpful feedback. We gave away tons of Sproutling merch too!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44781286/6b0aed2931a9fc254cb8b100a2111cc327be8e7c.png[/img]
Steam’s Next Fest in June was the perfect timing to showcase our demo update and Sproutling art refresh. You can also check out our YouTube channel for a [url=https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=l7oArC3Ywf4]developer interview[/url] with Máté for our Next Fest updates.

[table]
    [tr]
        [th][url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44781286/e36fc60b0f1d41ad21b2d2d4b26eb81ddcc1d2c5.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44781286/0bd1e81c9f2f1821609723fee0054093bd5d683d.png[/img][/url][/th]
        [th][url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44781286/85ea3b02135e694e0d0887412e2f3c9b19d24838.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44781286/ccb58445d524bad72e726568bd1e9c2c5cadb6c0.png[/img][/url][/th]
[th][url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44781286/6aa7deea1792b56f9fafc52881ac215712493c32.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44781286/ea8a26f7c502b3177dfed5de4bd36eba5ab0f737.png[/img][/url]
[/th]
    [/tr]
[/table]
There are other events that we joined like Earth Appreciation Fest and Games for Waves, and it has been a great pleasure for us to showcase Green Again alongside so many fun and unique titles. Now that our Sproutlings are well-rested after the holidays, they are ready to meet everyone in more new events in 2025!



And that’s a wrap for Green Again. What an amazing 2024! And we definitely couldn’t have done it without all of your support. Every demo download, every piece of feedback, every wishlist… they are all immense encouragement for us to keep expanding and improving our indie colony builder. Thank you for taking the time to play and wishlist Green Again, and please look forward to more new content for our game in 2025.

For the latest news and updates, please follow us on [url=https://discord.com/invite/pMFppmaEWh]Discord[/url], [url=https://twitter.com/greenagaingame]Twitter[/url], [url=https://tiktok.com/@greenagaingame]TikTok[/url] and Máté's [url=https://bsky.app/profile/mattsnippets.bsky.social]Bluesky[/url]! Hope everyone has a good start to 2025 and we'll see you again in the new year!

notes.title: Green Again Demo Update 🌿
notes.content:
Hey again, Sproutling fans! 

We've got a brand new demo update coming your way today, and we're excited to share some of the changes we've made. Shall we dive straight in?

[b]New Blueprint System[/b]

Sproutlings have a whole new way to build in this latest update to the demo: new buildings will appear as blueprints, with the surrounding workers carrying materials to the construction site to build the new addition. This will be expanded upon in a future update, so keep an eye out...

[b]UX Updates[/b]

It should now be easier than ever to manage your colony with our latest UX updates to the demo: trade buttons can now be held down to avoid repetitive clicking (this also works with shift and ctrl keys), a new borderless fullscreen mode allows for more seamless gameplay, and the objectives list has now been moved to the corner of the screen, to give you a better view of your colony. 

[b]Overlays[/b]

Managing your power production, crop growth, and seasons just got even simpler! With new overlays to show your farms and production, you can now see, at-a-glance, how your colony is doing and optimise where needed. Your Sproutlings will thank you.

Of course, we're also including the usual bug and performance fixes, including a more optimised and faster start up time for those of you with multiple save files, in this latest update - check out the full patch notes, below, for all the details! 

As always, don't forget to come join us on [url=https://discord.com/invite/pMFppmaEWh]Discord[/url], [url=https://twitter.com/greenagaingame]Twitter[/url], or [url=https://tiktok.com/@greenagaingame]TikTok[/url] to chat about the new update, ask any questions, or just show some Sproutling love. 

Changelog
[list]
[*] Optimization of animations, sproutling AI, CPU usage, and improving framerate
[*] Faster game startup and load game menu opening times even with high amount of save files
[*] Optimized garbage collection and querying of neighbor tiles
[*] Improved performance of disabling watchtowers
[*] Buildings appear as blueprints, sproutlings carry materials to construction site
[*] Selectable sproutlings and robots, displaying relevant info in inspector
[*] Unique names for sproutlings
[*] Overlay views for power production, crops grown, crop seasons and soil fertility
[*] Lack of water no longer prevents placing a higher level house on a lower level one to upgrade it
[*] Trade buttons can be held down for faster trading (works with ctrl and shift as well)
[*] Added borderless fullscreen support (can be toggled in options)
[*] List of objectives and buttons moved to upper right corner
[*] Fixed worker task scheduling issues
[*] Various bugfixes, UI and UX tweaks
[/list]

notes.title: We're Taking Part in Tacticon 2024 + Free Demo Update!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44781286/9cfb2cc63b2af8f75453087c0225a00390e81bc1.jpg[/img]

Hey again, Sproutling fans! 

We're very excited to share that Green Again is taking part in Tacticon 2024, a digital Steam convetion which seeks to highlight some of the best new & upcoming strategy games and the wonderful gamers that play them! 

The event runs from today (July 18th) to July 22nd, and you can see the full list of all the games included in the celebration [url=https://www.tacticon.games/selected-games-2024]here[/url].

Naturally, we wanted to provide an update alongside the event itself, so we've got some new features coming to Green Again, too! You can check out the full changelog below, but shall we take a look at the highlights?

[b]Multi-Swapping and Crop Updates[/b]

Crop management just got even easier! You can now choose to change all crops on adjacent fields of the same crop type. This can be toggled on or off so you can customise your experience depending on your playstyle. 
Crops now also provide different amounts of food and a bigger resource yield variety, depending on the crop choice too, and you'll have more tactical crop choices - make sure to use them wisely!

[b]Rainfall[/b]

Rainfall will now be an unlockable weather type in the Town Zone, and once unlocked, will mean that your fields are automatically watered during rain. There's a new objective in the Town Zone which is related to restoring rain, so keep an eye out for this when playing! 

[b]Quality of Life Updates[/b]

Naturally, there are plenty of Quality of Life changes in this new update, including the ability to scroll, zoom, and interact with the game whilst on the pause screen, lots of new sound effects for workers, robots, and ambience, and a new streamlined experience in the Town Zone map, with ancient buildings now closer together. 

[b]Full changelog: [/b]
[list]
[*] Swap all crops for adjacent fields of the same crop type (can be toggled)
[*] Crops worth different amount of food, bigger variety of crops' food/coins ratio
[*] Lots of new sound effects for workers, robots, ambience and more, spatial sounds spawned in the game world
[*] Rainfall as new unlockable weather in town zone (fields are watered when it's raining)
[*] Allow scrolling, zooming and interacting with the game while paused
[*] Moved ancient buildings closer in town zone
[*] Reduced materials selling value
[*] Gameplay settings available from main menu, settings UI tweaks, scroll speed setting
[*] Reduced weeds growth chance on more terraformed maps
[*] Made housing resource icon more visible
[*] Made world zone name tooltip pop up immediately
[*] Made closing all tutorials menu similar to other menus
[*] Hide bonus labels when hovering over an invalid placement tile
[*] Fix overly eager homeless warnings when replacing houses
[*] Separate icons for crops missing prerequisites and those that are unlockable but hasn't been unlocked
[*] Fix several issues related to tutorial reset and progress
[*] Fix worker disappearing at unreachable bridge end when building bridge
[*] Fix creative mode button shown again when reloading a save with unlocked creative
[*] Fix houses and flaggables leaving non-terraformed spots when cleared while their hex is still within hub radius
[*] Fix season icons and loading overlay scaling issues
[*] Fix unlocking creative in one zone unlocking it in other zones
[*] Fix visible pods button in town zone
[*] Fix EMP pods not cleaned up when overlapping
[*] Fix float saving issues related to locale (likely reason for volume settings not being saved for some players)
[*] Fix workers drawn under buildings when zoomed out
[*] Fix unknown zones marked as completed in tooltip after completing an actual zone
[*] Fix trade button enabled too soon
[*] Fix issues caused by removing powered down building
[*] Reduce camera panning jitter on very low FPS
[*] Various tutorial and UI text tweaks
[/list]

notes.title: We're taking part in Next Fest + an Update!
notes.content:
This. Is. Not. A. Drill. 
We're taking part in [b]Steam Next Fest[/b]! 

[previewyoutube=j92VcW6zfF4;full]TRAILER[/previewyoutube]
We're incredibly excited to be bringing Green Again to a whole new audience, and of course, participating in the event means we had to put a little update together, too - more details on that below! 

[b]Updated Tutorial[/b]

Whether you're a new player trying the demo for the first time, or have spent a little more time in Green Again, we've reworked the in-game tutorial to make it easier than ever to hit the ground running and get your colony growing. 
If you've played previously and would like to try the new tutorials (or just need a refresher!), start up a level and head to Settings > Gameplay > Reset Tutorial to experience it from scratch! 

[b]Lighting and Power[/b]

During the darker months, Sproutling homes, outposts, and lighting decorations will all require power at night, which you'll now need to provide for using a brand new power system: solar panels and batteries. Place solar panels during the warmer, brighter months in-game to generate power and store it in your batteries for use during these colder seasons to keep your Sproutlings happy! Watchtowers will also require power throughout the whole day, so you'll want to stock up as much as possible to be able to defend your colony. 

[b]New Music[/b] 

We've got a swanky new soundtrack in this latest update, written by the incredible [url=https://film-and-gamemusic.com/]Tobi Weiss[/url]! We don't want to spoil the joy of discovering it for you, so we'll just say this: new theme music and dynamic tracks which become richer as you expand your colony. You're welcome 🎶

All you have to do to access all these new additions is make sure you've updated to the latest version of the demo - so whether you're joining us from Next Fest or you've been around for a while, there's something new to enjoy 💚 Full changelog is below, but in the meantime, have you spotted our latest livestream?

notes.title: Green Again Demo Update!
notes.content:
Hey there, Sproutling fans! 

We've got an exciting new update for you today, and we're pretty keen to share it...so let's dive straight in, shall we?

[previewyoutube=Ir16DEy_KOw;full][/previewyoutube]

If you're following us on [url=https://twitter.com/greenagaingame]Twitter[/url] or [url=https://tiktok.com/@greenagaingame]TikTok[/url], you might've seen a little teaser last week...Sproutlings have had a makeover! They now have new animations, hairstyles, and facial expressions, which we happen to think makes them [i]even more adorable[/i]. 

It's not just the Sproutlings that have had a glow up, though - we've also got a brand new UI for you, with custom elements, a new font, and streamlined functionality to make it easier than ever to manage your Sproutlings (and keep them safe from pesky robots!), and we've spruced up the world map and changed the way zones are generated, so they're now a more circular shape. Fancy, eh?

Of course, with a new look and feel, it only felt right to do a little spring cleaning on how you manage your Sproutling colony; hungry or unhappy Sproutlings will now leave the settlement if they're not getting what they need, so you'll have to rise to the challenge.  
Luckily, higher level housing can now be placed over the lower level ones you might have started out with, so you can keep your decorations in place and upgrade your settlement without forfeiting Sproutling happiness. Phew!

We've also got some bug fixes and minor tweaks coming with this latest update, so you can read the full patch notes below for more information on those. 

As always, don't forget to come join us on [url=https://discord.com/invite/pMFppmaEWh]Discord[/url], [url=https://twitter.com/greenagaingame]Twitter[/url], or [url=https://tiktok.com/@greenagaingame]TikTok[/url] to chat about the new update, ask any questions, or just show some Sproutling love. 

Changelog:
[list]
[*] Brand new sproutling animations with various hairstyles, facial expressions, idle anims
[*] New UI with custom elements, font and icons, streamlined some UI functionality
[*] New world map (planet view with decorative tiles)
[*] Revised fog, buildings reveal fogged areas in a smooth circular radius
[*] Zones generated with circular shape (with cliffs at the borders)
[*] Hungry and unhappy sproutlings leave the settlement
[*] Higher level houses can be placed over lower level ones
[*] Variation in decoration costs, more expensive decorations give bigger happiness boost
[*] Watchtowers shoot light rays towards exposed bots
[*] Clear tool can be used to remove EMP pod from a tile
[*] Mapgen data loaded from data file for greater flexibility
[*] Huge cleanup of codebase to allow smoother updates and better performance
[*] Fixed various UI bugs
[*] Fixed loading glitch
[*] Fixed blinking no water icon on fields
[*] Misc fixes and economy tweaks
[/list]

notes.title: Green Again Demo Update
notes.content:
Hey there, Sproutling fans! 

We've got a new update to the demo for you, just in time for Dinos vs. Robots Fest, which we'll be participating in next week! 

There are some exciting new challenges to look forward to with this latest update, so shall we dive into the highlights?

First up on the agenda: [b]drones[/b]. These protective lil bots will now appear during [i]both[/i] zones in the demo, and they'll be tasked with defending the Ancient Buildings in the Town Zone, and the Transmitters in the Junkyard. They'll be able to harm your Sproutlings, so you might want to build some watchtowers...

Which brings us to our next point: Sproutling workers that are harmed now become [b]incapacitated[/b], turning them into Soul Seeds which need to be regrown in the aptly named Soul Garden. You'll be able to see your incapacitated workers as a separate stat in-game, so you can keep track of them! 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44781286/5daffdef1a48d490dfd2d4047c06547cdb776edd.png[/img]
We've also got some updated Sproutling management tools for you, allowing you to choose whether you'd like your Sproutlings to clear or gather from a tile, as well as giving you the option to [b]forbid[/b] them from using specific tiles - this will come in handy with those pesky drones on the loose! 

Of course, there are plenty more quality of life and bug fixes, including clearer tracking of food and consumption and production, expanded tutorials covering new topics, and lots more! You can read the full changelog down below. 

If you'd like to give us any feedback, have any questions, or just want to chat about the demo, don't forget to stop by our [url=https://discord.com/invite/pMFppmaEWh]Discord[/url], [url=https://twitter.com/greenagaingame]Twitter[/url], or [url=https://tiktok.com/@greenagaingame]TikTok[/url]! 

Changelog: 
[list]
[*] Workers can become incapacitated, turning into soul seeds and regrown at soul garden
[*] Drone added to both levels
[*] Watchtowers usable against drones, show watchtower range when selected
[*] Deeper population system with housing, active and incapacitated workers
[*] Forges generate materials per tick, not per day
[*] New food system with food units displayed instead of food days, more detailed tooltips
[*] Better looking and optimized shadows
[*] Detailed tooltips for materials, worker data etc.
[*] Forbid tool for preventing workers going into dangerous areas
[*] Tweaked building requirement UI
[*] Fixed some worker timer cleanup when exiting the map
[*] Fixed bridge construction site broken inspector
[*] Separate tools for gathering resources and clear buildings
[*] Fixed lots of inspector and description texts
[*] Expanded tutorial with new topics
[*] Reduced job durations
[*] Added notification system showing messages and alerts on the left
[*] Outpost coverage markers only shown for those placeables which require coverage
[*] Reduced decoration objective in town zone
[*] Tweaked objectives in junkyard zone
[*] Jellyfish leave when all transmitters have been captured
[*] Lots of small bugfixes and tweaks
[/list]

notes.title: We have a publisher (and a demo update)!
notes.content:
With a title like that, let's just get straight to the point...Green Again has found a publisher and will be published by Slug Disco.

Slug Disco are the developers of [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/463530/Empires_of_the_Undergrowth/]Empires of the Undergrowth[/url], and publishers of a range of nature themed titles and I'm beyond excited to be teaming up with them to make Green Again as successful and it could be.

[previewyoutube=OZYlbQ1J6qg;full][/previewyoutube]
[i]Looks like they'll need to update this reel 😏[/i]

In other, just as exciting news, Green Again recently got showcased by two big content creators - Angory Tom and Blitz both played the free demo and seemed to have a good time with it which was great to see.

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=vY2YvqS9_sE

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=R10mjeqqQt8

This got me thinking though, currently the game uses CC4 music, which [i]technically[/i] should be fine for content creators to use, but to avoid the hassle of any potential monetization issues for content creators, I've added a toggle for streamer mode which replaces the music with some custom in-house tracks.

The streamer mode is now live in today's update along with a range of other changes which you can see in full below.

If you haven't check the demo out yet, you can download it from the store page, and if you have any feedback be sure to stop by [url=https://discord.gg/pMFppmaEWh ]the Discord[/url]!

----

[list]
[*] New population system: outposts won't consume workers, they have a min. population requirement instead
[*] Added streamer mode for content creators, disabling CC4 songs
[*] Replaced rock resource with junk
[*] Several tweaks made to food calculation, upgrade and structure costs
[*] Building info panels are updated real-time when resources change
[*] Fixed camera scrolling and panning overshoot, snappier camera controls
[*] Using the clear tool continues to apply on/off depending on the first action, making quick clear marking big areas by LMB held down easier
[*] Tweaks and streamlining of tutorial
[*] Game preferences are now stored in a separate file
[*] Building captured state is shown in inspector
[*] Fixed short blink of zone hexes when loading world view
[*] Fixed inaccessible ancient buildings causing soft-lock
[*] House decoration quest works both ways: house placed next to decoration and vice versa
[*] Pods remain available in junkyard creative mode
[/list]
